svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.11.1.4 Adjoining Constructions
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.11 SOUND TRANSMISSION
Adjoining Constructions

g.text: Separating floor
Flanking wall: gypsum board on framing
that ends where it meets the structure
of the separating floor, (2)(b)
A
Separating floor, Sentence (2)
Double-stud separating wall
3: side-wall gypsum board interrupted at
the space between the stud rows. 4: joists
not continuous across the junction, with a
floor treatment from Table 9.11.1.4.
B
Separating wall, Sentences (3) and (4)
TABLE 9.11.1.4. FLOOR TREATMENTS OVER THE SUBFLOOR, BOTH SIDES OF THE FLOOR/WALL JUNCTION
W5, W6, W10, W12 (staggered studs)
wood strip flooring not less than 16 mm thick aligned parallel to separating wall, or
one layer of OSB or plywood not less than 15.5 mm thick plus finished flooring, or
one additional material layer plus finished flooring, combined mass per area not less than 8 kg/m²
W4, W11 (staggered studs)
one layer of OSB or plywood not less than 12.5 mm thick plus hardwood strip flooring not less than 19 mm
thick aligned parallel to separating wall, or one additional material layer plus finished flooring,
combined mass per area not less than 16 kg/m²
W8, W9 (staggered studs)
concrete or gypsum concrete topping not less than 19 mm thick bonded to the subfloor plus finished
flooring, or one additional material layer plus finished flooring, combined mass per area not less
than 32 kg/m²
W13, W14, W15 (double stud walls)
where the subfloor or other rigid materials connect the two rows of studs: hardwood strip flooring
not less than 16 mm, or OSB or plywood not less than 15.5 mm plus finished flooring, or an additional
layer plus finished flooring of not less than 8 kg/m². Not connected: any finished flooring
B1 to B10
any finished flooring
Separating wall with STC 50 or more, from Table 9.10.3.1.-A. Mass per area of materials: Note A-Table 9.11.1.4.

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
This Article applies where the protection follows
Clause 9.11.1.1.(1)(b) and compliance is
demonstrated under Clause 9.11.1.3.(2)(b)
Flanking wall assemblies connected to a separating
floor or ceiling assembly are of concrete or
concrete block over 200 kg/m² (40.96 lb/ft²), or
have a gypsum board finish
That is supported on wood or steel framing and ends or
is interrupted where it meets the structure of the
separating floor or ceiling assembly.
Flanking wall and ceiling assemblies connected to a
separating wall assembly are of concrete or concrete
block over 300 kg/m² (61.44 lb/ft²), or have a
gypsum board finish
Supported on wood or steel framing that ends or is
interrupted where it meets the structure of the
separating wall assembly or, for double-stud walls,
where it meets the space between the two lines of studs.
Flanking floor assemblies connected to a separating
wall assembly are of concrete over 300 kg/m², or to
Section 9.16., or on joists or trusses not
continuous across the junction
Covered with floor treatments in accordance with Table
9.11.1.4. for the applicable wall construction.
Drawn: framing slices seen from above, boards cut back to show the breaks. Sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.11.1.4. (page 9-104)
